name: AIR — Architecture Workspace
short_description: Design and review architecture dossiers with your AIR installation.
long_description: Official AIR workflow skills by Yannick Huchard, using the separately installed local AIR CLI. Requires Python 3.11+, local command execution, a selected AIR project/home and its authenticated loopback HTTP service. No MCP server or shared hosted backend is included or required by this variant. Installing the plugin does not install the engine. Public-directory eligibility and supported execution surfaces remain under product-specific review.
starter_prompts: Connect an authorized AIR installation to this project.
Review this architecture dossier using the configured AIR registry.
Prepare architecture handoff materials from this AIR baseline.
release_notes: Skills-only CLI review candidate. Explicit local engine dependency, actionable prerequisite diagnostics and synthetic reviewer recipe. Not submitted or approved; preserve existing draft.
